newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Pricer wins order from Turkey's Migros.
newsitem.headline: Pricer wins order from Turkey's Migros.

text.p: Swedish price label company Pricer said on Monday it had won an order from Turkish retail trader Migros for 500,000 electronic price labels.
"The value of the order is estimated at between $5-$8 million depending on how they're going to equip their shops," Pricer spokesman Lars Olde told Reuters.
"We will have more agreements of the same size as this in other countries later on this autumn."
Migros, the largest retail trader in Turkey, signed its first contract with Pricer in March 1996, Pricer said in a statement.
"Migros have now evaluated the Pricer system and its advantages. It is very satisfying that Migros' evaluation has led the company to this larger commitment," Olde said.
